description: Benchmark: run code-understanding questions against CodeGraph repo with/without Codindex MCP

questions.prompt: I need to understand the architecture of the CodeGraph project at /tmp/codegraph-bench. Answer these questions: (1) What are the main modules/packages? (2) How do they depend on each other? (3) What is the entry point and how does a typical request flow through the system? Be specific about the key files and their roles.

In the CodeGraph project at /tmp/codegraph-bench, trace the full extraction pipeline: how does a source file get parsed into graph nodes and edges? Start from the entry point, follow through file collection, tree-sitter parsing, call resolution, and database storage. List the key functions in the call chain and what each one does.
